summary: Repo-local static contract guards can verify structural source boundaries, but operator reports should label them as structural evidence rather than runtime-service proof or release readiness proof.
notes: Separate repo-local structural checks from runtime-service evidence.
Separate count, size, and type allowlist upload checks from stronger content-inspection guarantees.
Keep completion-gap reports split across repo-local closure, external-service verification, open-issue decisions, Core feedback, and propagation approval.
